create_IJepaConfig_default: create an IJepaConfig with default ijepa-base-patch16-224 configuration settings
create_IJepaConfig_custom: create an IJepaConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and patch_size parameters
initialize_IJepaModel: initialize an IJepaModel using an IJepaConfig configuration object
